content: "By Any Means" is the rock single MIM AL released on July 31, 2026. It runs 3:45, it is self-released, and it is the second track to pair the Montreal guitarist and songwriter with JazzPizza — following their first team-up on Odd Directions three months earlier.

Where Odd Directions was a 2:34 sprint, "By Any Means" takes its time. At more than a minute longer it is the heavier and more deliberate of the two collaborations, and Apple Music files it under Rock rather than the Alternative tag that covered the spring releases — a fair read of a track that leans hard into the guitar-forward side of MIM AL's writing while JazzPizza's vocal holds the centre.

It closes out a run of four MIM AL releases in 2026: Odd Directions in April, the self-titled MIM AL EP in May, and this single at the end of July. For a project that spent 2024 and 2025 putting out one song at a time, that is the busiest stretch in the catalogue so far.
"By Any Means" is out now on Spotify and Apple Music.
blog.inspiration: A follow-up to Odd Directions, written to push the MIM AL / JazzPizza collaboration somewhere heavier and give the idea more room than a two-and-a-half-minute single allows.
blog.recordingNotes: Released July 31, 2026 as a standalone single. Runtime 3:45. Featuring JazzPizza. Self-released (℗ 2026 MIM AL). Genre: Rock.

releases.title: MIM AL
releases.description: The self-titled EP — SHIMMER, ROSE and IN A WORLD

content: "MIM AL" is the self-titled EP, released May 7, 2026. Three tracks, fourteen minutes and thirty-five seconds, self-released: SHIMMER (6:04), ROSE (4:16) and IN A WORLD (4:15).

It is the first MIM AL release built as a body of work rather than a single. Everything before it — CHICKEN WITH It's HEAD CUT OFF, Dim Out the Lights, Not So Special, NoCebo — arrived one song at a time. Putting the project's own name on a set of three is the point: this is what MIM AL sounds like when the songs are allowed to sit next to each other.
ROSE came first. It went out as a standalone single on April 4, 2026, a month before the EP, and now sits at track two — the lead single that pulled the rest of the record into view.

SHIMMER opens, and at 6:04 it is the longest thing in the MIM AL catalogue by a wide margin — room for the math-rock and midwest-emo threads in the guitar writing to actually unwind instead of being compressed into a three-minute single. IN A WORLD closes at 4:15.
Apple Music classes the EP as Alternative. Stream all three tracks on Spotify and Apple Music.
blog.inspiration: The first MIM AL release conceived as a set rather than a single — three songs written to be heard in sequence, led out by ROSE a month ahead of the full EP.
blog.recordingNotes: Three-track self-titled EP released May 7, 2026. Total runtime 14:35. Tracklist: SHIMMER (6:04), ROSE (4:16), IN A WORLD (4:15). ROSE was issued separately as a single on April 4, 2026. Self-released (℗ 2026 MIM AL). Genre: Alternative.

releases.title: Odd Directions
releases.description: A short, sharp collaboration with JazzPizza

content: "Odd Directions" is the single MIM AL released on April 21, 2026, featuring JazzPizza. At 2:34 it is the shortest release in the catalogue — and the most direct.

That length is the whole design. There is no second act and no long outro: one idea, stated and carried through to the end, with nothing left over. Set against a track like CHICKEN WITH It's HEAD CUT OFF — nearly twice as long, with a guitar solo and a saxophone break — it shows the other end of how MIM AL writes.
It was the first of two collaborations with JazzPizza in 2026. The second, By Any Means, landed on July 31 and took the same partnership somewhere heavier and a minute longer.
"Odd Directions" also opened the busiest year in the project's history: this single in April, the self-titled MIM AL EP in May, and By Any Means in July.
Filed under Alternative. Out now on Spotify and Apple Music.
blog.inspiration: A first collaboration with JazzPizza, kept deliberately short — one idea carried start to finish with nothing left over.

releases.title: CHICKEN WITH It's HEAD CUT OFF

content: Teaming up with Montreal powerhouse Yung Kang Ra, MIM AL has delivered one of his most ambitious collaborations to date. This track pushes beyond genres, fusing the raw aggression of metal with the grit and swagger of hip hop. Yung Kang Ra's explosive vocals and razor-sharp lyricism cut through heavy guitar riffs and pounding drums, while MIM AL grounds the chaos with a bold, unflinching vision. The result is a song that refuses to be ignored—loud, intense, and unapologetically alive.

The song itself is a whirlwind of emotions: rage, defiance, self-reflection, and relentless energy. From the primal hook repeating "fucked up, lucked out" to verses that explore the highs of ambition and the lows of destructive cycles, it captures the chaos of modern life with brutal honesty. Adding to the chaos is a blazing guitar solo and an unexpected yet powerful saxophone performance by Nathan Bissonette, giving the track an edge that's both chaotic and strangely elegant.

For MIM AL, this release marks a turning point. Stepping outside of his comfort zone, he's proven his ability to blur lines between genres and carve out his own sonic identity. It's more than just a collaboration—it's a statement piece. With Yung Kang Ra by his side, MIM AL has created a track that not only showcases his evolution as an artist but also sets a new standard for the kind of fearless, genre-breaking music coming out of Montreal's underground scene.
blog.inspiration: Lyrics for CHICKEN WITH It's HEAD CUT OFF
blog.recordingNotes: The majority of the track was recorded at the legendary Breakglass Studio in Montreal, where MIM AL and Yung Kang Ra laid down the foundation of the song. With the expertise of engineer Jalil Khayat guiding the sessions, every layer of sound was captured with precision. The final mix and master were handled by Daniel Sultarz, whose touch elevated the track into the explosive, polished masterpiece it became.

releases.title: Not So Special
releases.description: A raw exploration of feeling ordinary in an extraordinary world

content: In a world of complex compositions, 'Not So Special' finds beauty in simplicity. This instrumental track emerged from late-night studio sessions where the guitar became a voice for unspoken emotions.
The opening melody came to me during one of those quiet moments of reflection. Each note carries the weight of introspection, creating an ambient soundscape that speaks without words.
This piece explores the concept that not everything needs to be extraordinary to be meaningful. Sometimes the most profound statements come from the gentlest touches on the strings.
The recording captures the raw, intimate moments between artist and instrument. Every sustain, every gentle bend tells part of the story of finding peace in being authentically yourself.
This track represents the core of what Mim Al's instrumental journey is about: guitar music that doesn't need lyrics to communicate deep emotional truths.
blog.inspiration: Written during a period of embracing minimalism and finding beauty in simple, honest guitar melodies.
blog.recordingNotes: Recorded in a single take using a clean Telecaster through a warm tube amp, capturing the natural room acoustics.

releases.title: Dim Out the Lights
releases.description: When darkness becomes your comfort zone

content: There's something magical about music in low light. 'Dim Out the Lights' was born from that intimate space where guitar and atmosphere merge into something ethereal.

This instrumental track explores the sonic territory between ambient and melodic guitar work. The piece moves through different emotional landscapes, all painted with careful note choices and atmospheric textures.
The guitar work shifts between clean, crystalline tones and warm, saturated passages. It's the musical equivalent of watching shadows dance on the wall - familiar yet mysterious.
What started as a simple chord progression became an exploration of space and silence. The pauses between notes are as important as the notes themselves, creating a breathing, living composition.
This track showcases the more ambient side of instrumental guitar, where melody serves emotion rather than technical display.
blog.inspiration: Inspired by the peaceful solitude of evening hours when the world quiets down and music can truly be heard.
blog.recordingNotes: Recorded with ambient microphone placement to capture the natural reverb of the room, creating an intimate listening experience.

releases.title: NoCebo
releases.description: Contemplative instrumental exploring the power of musical healing

content: Music often carries a therapeutic quality, and NoCebo leans into that idea through gentle, restrained guitar work. The title plays on the opposite of placebo—the belief that something might harm when it actually helps—challenging listeners to reconsider their expectations.

What might at first sound melancholic gradually unfolds into something more hopeful, revealing layers of resolution for those willing to sit with it. Each note, bend, and sustain is placed with intent, prioritizing emotional weight over technical showmanship.
This track came together as a collaborative effort:
- LOOWI contributed an expressive and soulful keyboard solo.
- MYIASIS (Germany) laid down the drums, giving the piece its heartbeat.
- Menflou handled production, mixing, and mastering, bringing everything into balance.
At its core, NoCebo is a reflection on vulnerability as strength—the idea that honest musical expression can be both healing for the listener and cathartic for the creator.
blog.inspiration: Written during a period of personal reflection on the healing power of music and the importance of emotional honesty in art.
blog.recordingNotes: Recorded with a focus on natural dynamics and authentic performance, using minimal processing to preserve the raw emotional content.

releases.title: Sudden Confusion
releases.description: Intricate instrumental capturing moments of uncertainty and clarity

content: Life's unexpected moments often create the most honest music. 'Sudden Confusion' captures that feeling of being caught off-guard by circumstances, translated into instrumental guitar language.
The composition moves through different emotional states - from uncertainty to clarity, from chaos to resolution. Each section represents a different aspect of processing unexpected change.

Technically, this piece showcases advanced guitar techniques in service of emotional storytelling. Complex passages give way to simple, heartfelt melodies, mirroring how confusion can lead to clarity.
The recording captures the spontaneous nature of the composition, with several sections recorded in single takes to preserve the authentic emotional response to the musical ideas.
This track demonstrates how instrumental music can tell complex emotional stories without the need for words.
blog.inspiration: Created during a period of major life changes, exploring how music can help process and understand complex emotions.
blog.recordingNotes: This track was a collaboration between MIM AL and drummer Carl.

releases.title: Contrast in May
releases.description: 4-track EP exploring seasonal emotions through instrumental guitar

content: Contrast in May represents the full spectrum of seasonal emotional change captured in four distinct instrumental pieces. Each track corresponds to a season, creating a complete emotional journey.
The EP features Fall (Bleeze), Summer (Green), Spring (Hidden Tattoos), and Winter (Feeling Doodoo) - each piece reflecting the unique emotional palette of its corresponding season.
This collection showcases the evolution of Mim Al's sound over time, demonstrating how instrumental guitar can capture the nuanced feelings that come with seasonal transitions.
The recording process spanned several months, allowing each track to be created during its corresponding season for authentic emotional resonance.
blog.inspiration: Inspired by the cyclical nature of seasons and how they mirror our internal emotional landscapes.
blog.recordingNotes: Each track was recorded during its corresponding season to capture the authentic emotional essence of that time of year.

releases.title: Bleeze
releases.description: The breakout single that started it all

content: Bleeze was the track that started everything. What began as a simple guitar idea became the foundation for Mim Al's entire musical journey.
This instrumental piece captures the raw energy and emotional honesty that would become signature elements of the Mim Al sound. Every note feels necessary, nothing is wasted.
The recording process was intentionally minimal - just guitar, amp, and honest expression. This stripped-down approach allowed the emotion to shine through without any studio tricks.
Years later, Bleeze still represents the core philosophy: authentic expression through instrumental guitar, where the music speaks for itself.
blog.inspiration: The first genuine expression of the Mim Al sound - honest, direct, and emotionally resonant.
blog.recordingNotes: Recorded in a single session with minimal overdubs, capturing the pure essence of the original musical idea.
